item.title: CVE-2026-117588 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Google Review Slider WordPress plugin before 18.11 does not perform nonce validation when updating its active Google Places configuration, allowing attackers to alter or destroy that configuration via a forged request, provided they can trick a site administrator into following a crafted link.

item.title: CVE-2026-118528 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not validate that the requesting user owns the referenced listing before returning its metadata via an AJAX action, allowing authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to disclose another user's private and unpublished draft listing details, including contact information.

item.title: CVE-2026-118529 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify that a user owns a listing before processing a featured-listing checkout for it, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to publish and feature another user's pending listing when the featured listing fee is set to zero.

item.title: CVE-2026-118530 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not check that the acting user may edit each targeted user when handling an email-verification bulk action on multisite, allowing an Administrator of one site on the network to lock out users of other sites, including the network Super Administrator, until they re-verify their email.

item.title: CVE-2026-118532 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify ownership of attachment IDs supplied when updating a listing's images, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access and above to permanently delete arbitrary media library attachments, including those uploaded by administrators, along with their files.

item.title: CVE-2026-118533 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify that the user requesting an order's payment receipt owns that order, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to disclose other users' order and payment information, including amounts, payment method, payment status and transaction ID.

item.title: CVE-2026-118534 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify that the order targeted by its checkout payment-retry REST action belongs to the requesting user, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to create payment-attempt records against other users' orders.

item.title: CVE-2026-119073 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.23 does not escape a pagination setting supplied through its post-listing module shortcodes before outputting it in an HTML attribute, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121379 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Tournamatch WordPress plugin before 4.7.1 does not validate or restrict the path of a previously stored profile or team image before deleting it when a new image is uploaded, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to delete arbitrary files on the server, such as wp-config.php, which can lead to a full site takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-121380 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Tournamatch WordPress plugin before 4.7.1 does not restrict access to its team invitation listing, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the email addresses of people invited to join teams.

item.title: CVE-2026-121491 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not validate or escape a request header before writing it into a PHP file it regenerates on an unprotected admin hook, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code when its custom database error page is enabled and they win a race against an administrator saving its settings.

item.title: CVE-2026-121492 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not have authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to change the order of arbitrary posts, including drafts, private posts and navigation menu items, as well as the order of taxonomy terms when term ordering is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-121796 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Add From Server Lite WordPress plugin before 6.0.0 does not restrict SVG uploads to users allowed to post unfiltered HTML, allowing users with the Author role and above to upload SVG files containing JavaScript and perform Stored XSS attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121848 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Magic Link WordPress plugin before 2.2.6 does not check that the user requesting a login link is authorised to generate one for the chosen account, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to generate a working login link for an administrator and log in as them.

item.title: CVE-2026-121857 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner WordPress plugin before 3.1.14 does not check that a user may manage WooCommerce orders before returning or removing ticket data for any order, allowing any role an administrator has granted access to the Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner WordPress plugin before 3.1.14's admin area (down to Subscriber) to view other customers' ticket codes and names and to remove tickets from their orders.

item.title: CVE-2026-121858 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner WordPress plugin before 3.2.9 does not properly escape a search value before using it in SQL queries in several of its admin listings, allowing users with access to its admin area (administrators by default, or any role granted access in its settings) to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121866 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The iLeads SMS Gateway by Exsile WordPress plugin before 2.0.0 does not check capabilities or nonces in several AJAX actions that update a site option chosen by the request, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to change arbitrary WordPress options and escalate to administrator, for example by enabling registration with administrator as the default role.

item.title: CVE-2026-122001 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Komfortkasse for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.4.9 does not properly validate the authenticity of REST API requests, overriding WordPress's own nonce verification so that a request forged in a logged-in administrator's browser is accepted, which can be used to create a new administrator account and fully take over the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-97189 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not perform a read-permission check when it renders and formats the values of its relational fields, allowing users with post-editing access (Contributor and above) to disclose the titles and non-public statuses of other users' unpublished posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-97190 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the target object before writing to it during bidirectional relationship synchronization, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to add or remove a reference to their own object on arbitrary posts, users, or terms they cannot otherwise edit.

item.title: CVE-2026-97191 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not re-apply its field-group location rules when persisting values submitted through the post editor save path, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to write custom fields the site restricted to administrators onto their own posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-103917 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The The Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) – Quiz Maker & Survey Maker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary shortcode execution in all versions up to, and including, 11.2.7. This is due to the software allowing users to execute an action that does not properly validate a value before running do_shortcode. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shortcodes. The submission nonce is dispensed to any unauthenticated caller by the public wp_ajax_nopriv_qsm_create_quiz_nonce endpoint, meaning it functions as a CSRF token rather than an authorization barrier and imposes no meaningful obstacle to exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2026-115811 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Strong Testimonials plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'star_rating' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.16 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful execution requires an administrator to open the standard Preview link for a pending testimonial, a step the plugin's normal moderation workflow naturally invites.

item.title: CVE-2026-116558 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Unlimited Elements for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<title>/<description> inside the attacker-controlled RSS feed body' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.26 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable against any site whose administrator has placed the RSS Feed catalog widget pointing at a feed URL the attacker controls, as the plugin's own 2.0.25 escaping pre-processor intentionally excludes |raw prints in element content positions from its escaping logic, and XML entity-encoded payloads in feed item titles are decoded back to raw markup before reaching the sink.

item.title: CVE-2026-116621 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Ultimate Member – User Profile, Registration, Login, Member Directory, Content Restriction & Membership Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'pm_note (any custom Textarea metakey with html disabled)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.14.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a privileged victim to click the attacker-rendered anchor on the target profile page, which triggers the DOM gadget that concatenates the unescaped data-src value into an HTML string passed to jQuery.

item.title: CVE-2026-118048 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The WP Data Access plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the Simple Form autocomplete lookup label in versions up to, and including, 5.5.89 This is due to insufficient output escaping on the value returned by WPDA_Autocomplete::autocomplete_lookup() when it is emitted into a single-quoted HTML attribute by WPDA_Simple_Form_Item_Autocomplete::show_item() (the escape-output lint is explicitly suppressed on the echo line). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, who are permitted to edit a lookup row through a legacy Form, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user — including a higher-privileged user editing a linked record that uses the autocomplete relationship — accesses the injected page.

item.title: CVE-2026-118204 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The WP Data Access – App Builder for Tables, Forms, Dashboards, Charts & Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'ImageURL column value (populated from wp_usermeta.description in the demonstrated path)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.5.89 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to have published a DataTables shortcode over a database column the attacker controls (e.g., wp_usermeta.description) with the Image URL media type assigned to that column — both are supported plugin features but are not enabled by default.

item.title: CVE-2026-118800 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The aBlocks – Gutenberg Blocks, User Dashboard Builder, Popup Builder, Form Builder & Animation Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'headingTag' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

item.title: CVE-2026-118801 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | The aBlocks – Gutenberg Blocks, User Dashboard Builder, Popup Builder, Form Builder & Animation Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.18.0 via the 'id' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to extract the full rendered body content of any password-protected post of any post type by embedding the shortcode with the target post's ID. Author-level attackers and above can additionally publish a post embedding the shortcode, exposing the password-protected content to unauthenticated visitors.

item.title: CVE-2026-120479 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The WP Data Access – App Builder for Tables, Forms, Dashboards, Charts & Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the Data Projects front-end simple form in versions up to, and including, 5.5.90 This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on the value of TEXT/TINYTEXT/MEDIUMTEXT/LONGTEXT columns rendered by the WPDA_Simple_Form_Item_Textarea::show_item() method, which emits the stored column value directly inside a <textarea> element after only replacing '&' with '&'. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

item.title: CVE-2026-120515 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The SEOPress – AI SEO Plugin & On-site SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'seopress_google_analytics_affiliate_tracking' and 'seopress_google_analytics_download_tracking' settings in versions up to, and including, 10.3. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on these settings as they are interpolated into the inline Google Analytics tracking snippet by seopress_google_analytics_js(): the affiliate value receives no sanitization at all (it is omitted from inc/admin/sanitize/Sanitize.php) and lands inside a <script> block, while the download value is only passed through sanitize_text_field() and lands inside a JavaScript regular-expression literal that preserves parentheses, semicolons and slashes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above (where an administrator has delegated the SEOPress 'analytics' capability under Settings > Advanced > Security — the precondition Wordfence accepted for CVE-2026-101357), to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

item.title: CVE-2026-120530 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.7
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.7 | The WebToffee WP Backup and Migration plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to subsequently perform the plugin's ordinary local database export and restore operation on the same site, which is this plugin's primary intended function. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The TranslatePress – Translate Multilingual sites with AI Translation plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment (storage); originals / language / original_language (exfiltration from endpoint)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-121536 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | The WP Data Access – App Builder for Tables, Forms, Dashboards, Charts & Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'engine' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.5.90 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. item.title: CVE-2026-121792 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The GamiPress – Gamification plugin to reward points, badges & ranks in WordPress, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'input_<field_id>.<part> (Gravity Forms name-field part, or list-field row)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires a GamiPress achievement already configured against a Gravity Forms 'field value submission' event with the corresponding form published — a standard setup for sites using the integration.

item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The AgenWebsite Shipping – Plugin Ongkos Kirim & Generate Resi Otomatis Semua Kurir Indonesia plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'zipcode' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.2.41 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-122265 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | The Vanquish Upload Files for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.13 via the 'vanupfi_file_name' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. The authorization bypass is achieved by supplying a non-existent order ID (e.g., '.pdf'), which causes wc_get_order() to return false and short-circuits the vanupfi_user_can_access_order_files() check, while the is_pdf() branch selector's loose strpos() substring match allows a traversal payload such as '../.pdf/../../../../wp-config.php' to satisfy the PDF branch and be streamed verbatim via readfile().

item.title: CVE-2026-83495 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | A flaw was found in the Trainer v2 TrainJob API. A user with permissions to create TrainJobs can exploit this by injecting `valueFrom.secretKeyRef` into environment variable definitions. This allows them to read and exfiltrate sensitive information (secrets) from the namespace, leading to a privilege escalation. This occurs when the TrainJob Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) is broader than the Secret read RBAC.

item.title: CVE-2026-87112 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | The QA Assistants – Driven by data plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.0 via the 'dlevent_ver' parameter. This is due to unrestricted PHP deserialization via wrap_unserialize_static() calling unserialize() without an allowed_classes restriction, combined with serialize_escape() failing to sanitize path traversal sequences in the raw_name parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object. The Guzzle FileCookieJar gadget present in the plugin's bundled Composer dependencies can be leveraged to perform an Arbitrary File Write, writing attacker-controlled content to an attacker-chosen filename, which can result in Remote Code Execution. Exploitation requires triggering the qahm_cron_data_manage scheduled event via wp-cron.php to invoke the deserialization sink against a planted queue file, but this endpoint requires no authentication and fires automatically on a two-minute schedule.

item.title: CVE-2026-93370 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | The Paystack WooCommerce Payment Gateway plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 5.8.5 via the 'key' parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract customer PII — including billing name, email address, phone number, billing address, shipping address, and purchased product list — embedded into page HTML via wp_localize_script by enumerating sequential order IDs. This is only exploitable when the merchant has enabled the optional custom metadata feature in the Paystack gateway settings.
